text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Alright. Deep breath... and done!
Sorry to keep you waiting, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: All the preparations to win are completely ready!
choice_data_list: You're fully fired up, aren't you.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: I'll make sure to finish at the top this time. No, wait, I'm taking 1st place!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: You think this is just like me too, don't you?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Mmhmm.
A fine response indeed, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Alright then, I'm heading out.
—To the race, and to victory!

Overflowing with fighting spirit,
Tokai Teio headed toward the stage of competition.
